name: SnowRunner: Season 17 - Repair & Rescue
storyline:
Breathe new life into the mountainous region of Zurdania and help key industries get back on their feet! Following a bad streak of adverse weather and crop failures, you’re hired to rehabilitate fields, renovate historical landmarks and boost tourism across two new 4km² maps.

• Two new 4km² maps set in Zurdania. Revive the region’s agriculture and help locals attract tourists by renovating monuments and building a hotel complex.

• Two new vehicles: the Voron G-5352, a Heavy-class multi-purpose truck able to perform a wide variety of tasks from pulling medium trailers to carrying supplies for long-range missions, and the Jangsu RX600, a very agile and fuel-efficient Off-Road truck that will shine as a support specialist, or as a cargo hauler for light and medium loads.

• New activities: Help Zurdania become self-sufficient! Improve soil fertility, introduce new farming techniques and develop sustainable agriculture for the future. Once fields are taken care of, support local tourism by renovating the region’s historical monasteries and building a major hotel complex to host visitors.

Season 17: Repair & Rescue is included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.
summary: Welcome to Zurdania! Breathe new life into the region by helping locals rehabilitate fields, renovate historical landmarks and boost tourism. Season 17: Repair & Rescue is included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.
